deals.title: Barnes & Noble Criterion Collection 50% off (4K included)
deals.detail: Reported to start today (Fri Nov 6) and run through Sun Dec 6: half off all in-stock Criterion 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD discs, including preorders. Dates come from collector posts and are not yet confirmed on B&N's site; Amazon often price-matches many Criterion 4Ks.

deals.title: In the Mouth of Madness (Arrow 4K UHD limited edition)

deals.title: Friday the 13th (Arrow 4K Ultra HD edition)
deals.detail: Arrow's 4K UHD edition for $25 (list $50) on Amazon, posted mid-October.

deals.title: Star Trek 4K UHD Blu-rays
